jobs.name: TreasureChest
jobs.prompt: A chunky stylized low-poly game-art treasure chest, closed, flat-shaded facets, bold clean colors: dark weathered wooden planks with rounded corners, thick brass bands and a big brass lock plate, a slightly domed lid, barnacles and a little green seaweed on one corner, sitting half-sunk in a small mound of pale sand, soft lighting, no background, no text.
